nodes.title: Film Collection: Factory & Trade Work, get paid per hour of footage
nodes.description:
- READ THE ENTIRE GUIDE BEFORE STARTING (link in additional notes)
- Eligibility: You work in a real factory / production line (automotive parts, food and beverage production, packaging, electronics assembly, textiles) or do skilled trade work with real tools (welding, auto repair, carpentry, jewelry, tailoring). Retail stores, restaurants, offices, and desk work do NOT count.
- Home tasks do NOT count
- Use an eligible phone: iPhone 11 or newer
- Mount the phone at forehead level angled down 45 degrees, both hands in frame 95% of the time, and film your real work at a natural pace
- Each clip: one continuous take, 10 minutes minimum. Keep filming until you reach at least 1 hour of total verified footage, the app tracks your progress
- When you slide to attempt, the Whop app opens capture mode and walks you through it. Upload happens automatically inside Whop
- Only film where you are allowed to, and keep other people out of frame

Additional notes:
Guide: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Nf67z-ZPS3ybu-WiVSz6UMuB_54K0q1-/view

Acceptable settings and tasks (also in guide):
- Factory: Automotive parts plant, food and beverage production line, pharmaceutical packaging, electronics assembly, chemical processing, textile mill.
- Trade / workshop: Welding shop, auto repair bay, custom carpentry or woodworking, jewelry fabrication, small-batch workshop or lab.

Footage is reviewed against the guide, clips with hands out of frame, long idle, staged work, or excluded settings get rejected. By submitting, you confirm you only film spaces you have the right to film and consent to commercial use of your footage.

Affiliate Program:
You receive 20% of the bounty reward if you refer a friend who successfully completes this bounty! Share the link with other Factory and Trade workers.
